desc: Henry Big Boy Carbine Lever-Action Rifles are a modern carry-over of the Trapper classics of the past. It combines the features of Henry's legendary Big Boy rifle with the quick handling of a shorter, lighter carbine barrel length. These are the the ideal brush guns for tight spaces, and they give up nothing in accuracy. Attention to detail in the great Western styling including the large loop lever. Blued-finish octagonal barrels are outfitted with a classic fully adjustable semi-buckhorn rear sight with a reversible white diamond insert and a brass beaded front-sight. Tubular magazine holds seven rounds. Both the straight-grip stock and forearm are crafted of select American-walnut accented with a brass barrel band and Henry's recognizable brass receiver. Tubular magazine holds seven rounds.
